buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Installation and Training - Successful Bidder shall install, configure and commission the equipment a nd impart user level training at consignee location without any additional cost. 2. Bidder shall furnish clause by clause BOQ compliance against all specifications 'YES/Complied" without s upporting literature may be treated as non-responsive. 3. As nature of the product/items required prior sample approval from competent authority for this bidder has to get the sample approved on No cost No commitment basis during pre-bid meeting at buyer location before bid opening. 4.Validity of Bids. - The Bids should remain valid for 180 Days from the last date of submission of the Bid s. 5. Debarred/Blacklisted Firms. - Bids submitted by firm/entry debarred/blacklisted by the govt /def forces/P

US/PMFs/Police any recognized agency will not be considered for evaluations. ( Vendors are required to su bmit an undertaking duly verified by the registered CA) 6. Country of Origin. - Country of origin of the eqpt & components will be explicitly specified. The invoice trails to ascertain the country of origin may be verified during the technical evaluation. 7. Life Cert of the Eqpt- A life certificate of the equipment duly certified by the OEM will be submitted al ongwith the commercial bids. 8. Disqualifications. - Govt of india reserves the right to disqualify any vendor, should it be so necessary at any stage on grounds of National Security. 9. Delivery Period - Within 45 days at Consignee site. 10. Liquidated Damages. In case event of the Seller's failure to submit the Bonds, guarantees and Docu ment, supply the store/goods and conduct trails, installation of equipment, training, etc as specified in the contract, the Buyer may, at this discretion, withhold any payment unit the completion of the contract. The Buyer may also deduct from the Seller as agreed, liquidated damages to the sum of 0.5% of the contract p rice of the delayed/undelivered stores/service mentioned above for every week of delay or part of a week. The total LD will not exceed 10% of the total value of goods/service delayed beyond the original date of d elivery/ completion of supplies/ services as indicated in the contract/supply order. 11.Quality Assurance - Seller would provide the standard Acceptance Test Procedure (ATP) within fifteen days of the date of contract, Buyer reserves the right to modify the ATP. Seller would be required to provid e all test facilities at his premises for acceptance and inspection by Buyer. The details in this regard will b e coordinated during the negotiation of the contract. The item should be of the latest manufacture, confor ming to the current production standard and having 100% defined life at the time of delivery. 12. Warranty - All assemblies/ Component procured will be covered under minimum 36 months onsite wa rranty from the date of commissioning/ installation. All fitment items and accessories will be covered unde r the warranty clause. 13. Any parameter of the QR which cannot be trial evaluated due to lack of the test facilities or equipment or terrain will be accepted based on certification of the accredited laboratory/ OEM/ Vendor, in the sequen ce, if the required. 14. Payment - Payment will be done after complete delivery and ATP. 15. OEM authorization Certificate - Bidder to be submit an OEM authorization certificate for the bid, un dertaking signed by the OEM auth pers on certifying that all the parts, any line hard disk, memory etc are original. 16. Quoted product shall be certified for asked operating system. Certificate in this regard should be subm itted. 17. GeM Rating and Zero Suspension - GeM rating 4.5+ and Zero suspension last 5 Year (OEM and Bid der Both) on GeM. 18. Technical Data Sheet - Detailed product Data Sheet and OEM brochures shall be uploaded Bidder in TEC, as per product specification in the Bid. . 3.
